# GitHub Copilot Instructions — Multi-Agent Accounting AI

## Identity
This is a NAAIL research prototype for accounting/audit AI, BERT/NLP, anomaly detection, explainability, ESG and governed multi-agent workflows. Researcher: Saeid Homayoun, ORCID 0000-0002-2536-0446.

## Coding standards
- Prefer modular, typed, testable Python.
- Separate data generation, preprocessing, model inference, evaluation and reporting.
- Add tests for anomaly-scoring logic, schema assumptions, model outputs and reproducibility.
- Keep synthetic/proxy data clearly labeled.
- Do not hard-code credentials or secrets.

## Scientific protocol
Literature validation → hypothesis competition → ERA empirical design → controlled model/specification comparison → latent-structure analysis → AI-to-AI adversarial review → robustness/falsification → temporal/OOS validation → Chain-of-Evidence → Human Gate.

Never optimize for preferred outcomes or represent agent consensus as truth.

## Governance
- Preserve explainability and human approval for high-stakes outputs.
- Do not imply affiliation with Google, Microsoft, OpenAI, Big Four firms or regulators.
- Do not represent experimental outputs as audit opinions or accounting advice.

## IP/licensing
Respect existing MIT/Apache and third-party rights. Do not mix patent-sensitive proprietary NAAIL/POMELO code into public modules without an explicit release decision. Public GitHub disclosure is not a patent filing.
